{{Quote|The Sith must be ruled by a single leader, the very embodiment of the strength and power of the dark side. If the leader grows weak, another must rise to seize the mantle.|[[Darth Revan's Sith Holocron]]|<ref name="Darth Bane: Path of Destruction" />}}
The title '''Dark Lord of the Sith''', or '''[[Jen'ari]]''' in the [[Sith (language)|Sith language]], originally referred to the rulers of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], such as those entombed in [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban's]] [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]]; subsequently, it was shared by multiple [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] simultaneously. Some Sith Lords had the prefix [[Darth/Legends|Darth]], but not all were Dark Lords. From the [[Golden Age of the Sith]] until their fall in the [[New Sith Wars]], there was typically only one Dark Lord of the Sith at a time who headed the Sith Order, with one Dark Lord succeeding the other, as was the case with [[Marka Ragnos]] and his successor, [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], who initiated the failed [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. The Sith Lord [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] declared himself [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Sith Emperor]] and founded a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], where all of his twelve [[Dark Council]]lors held the title of Dark Lord at the same time. The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] and [[Darth Malak]] also claimed the Dark Lord title for themselves during the [[Jedi Civil War]], as did the [[Sith Triumvirate]] that succeeded them.

After deceiving [[Skere Kaan]]'s [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] into destruction at [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] instituted the [[Order of the Sith Lords]]' [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], dictating that there should only be one [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] and one [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] at a time, with only the Master being a Dark Lord of the Sith. However, by the time of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], both the Master and the Apprentice were Dark Lords of the Sith. The term referred to individuals of any [[Gender/Legends|gender]], though [[Lumiya]] claimed the title of '''Dark Lady of the Sith'''. The [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], who descended from Sith survivors of the Great Hyperspace War, were ruled by a [[Grand Lord]] and his [[Circle of Lords]] rather than a Dark Lord, while [[Darth Krayt]] of the [[One Sith]] assumed the mantle of Dark Lord.

==History==
===Sith Empire===
{{Quote|I now complete your initiation to the power of the dark side...so that you may bring to pass the great destiny foretold...Exar Kun, because of you, the Sith will ''never'' die...you have rightly earned the title of...''Dark Lord of the Sith''!|Marka Ragnos bestows upon Exar Kun the title of Dark Lord of the Sith|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 6" />}}
[[File:NagaIsTheDarkLord.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Naga Sadow receives his mark of Lordship.]]
[[Xendor]], leader of the [[Legions of Lettow]] during the [[First Great Schism]], was seen by [[Sorzus Syn]] of the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]]'s [[Exiles]] as a predecessor to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lords]] of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] they had created. Although Xendor was not a Sith Lord in his lifetime,<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> his [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] was rumored to have returned as the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Dark Underlord]] during the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="END">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref>

The first Dark Lord of the Sith was [[Ajunta Pall]], the leader of the exiled Dark Jedi who, after their defeat in the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]], conquered the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]] and ruled over them as gods.<ref name="BoS" /> The title was subsequently passed down from Dark Lord to Dark Lord, [[Tulak Hord]] among them,<ref name="Khem">{{Holonet|companions|khem-val|Khem Val}}</ref> until the time of [[Marka Ragnos]], whose century-long reign brought about the [[Golden Age of the Sith]]. Ragnos' death in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] created a power struggle between the Sith Lords [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] and [[Ludo Kressh]], who held opposing views on the future of the Empire.<ref name="Gold2" /> Though both claimed the title of Dark Lord, Sadow, plotting to incite a [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|war]] between the Sith and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], convinced the [[Sith Council]] to appoint him Dark Lord<ref name="Gold3">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 3|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 3]]</ref> and forced [[Ludo Kressh's faction|Kressh's faction]] to flee into exile.<ref name="Gold5">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 5]]</ref> After the Republic defeated the [[Sith invasion fleet]], Kressh came out of exile with his followers and declared himself the Dark Lord, but Sadow's faction quickly [[First battle of Korriban|killed him and wiped out his faction]]. Sadow then fled to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] to avoid being captured by the Republic.<ref name="Fall5">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 5]]</ref>

While on Yavin 4, Sadow froze himself in suspended animation. [[4400 BBY|600 years later]], a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] named [[Freedon Nadd]] awoke Sadow and convinced Sadow to share the Sith teachings with him. Upon completing his apprenticeship, Nadd killed Sadow<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> and declared himself Dark Lord of the Sith.<ref name="JvS" />

[[3997 BBY|1003 years after the fall of the Sith Empire]],<ref name="NEC" /> the spirit of Marka Ragnos<ref name="JvS" /> declared [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] Dark Lord of the Sith.<ref name="Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 6" /> At the same time, everyone on the [[Dark Council]] of the [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Sith Emperor]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]]'s [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] also held the title of Dark Lord of the Sith, a first in Sith history.<ref name="SWTOR" /> After discovering the long lost [[Star Forge]],<ref name="T8">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 8: The Jedi Civil War|int=Timeline 8: The Jedi Civil War}}</ref> [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] broke free of Vitiate's mental control<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> and declared himself the Dark Lord of the Sith of his new [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|empire]]. [[Darth Malak|Malak]] succeeded Darth Revan as the Dark Lord of the Sith after overthrowing him, until he was defeated by his former Sith Master.<ref name="KOTOR" />

===Rule of Two===
{{Expandsect}}
{{Quote|When your power eclipses mine I will become expendable. This is the Rule of Two: one Master and one apprentice. When you are ready to claim the mantle of Dark Lord as your own, you must do so by eliminating me. The confrontation is inevitable. It is the only way the Sith can survive. It is the way of the dark side.|Darth Bane, to Zannah|<ref name="RoT" />}}
More than two thousand years later, Lord Kaan granted the title to all members of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]].<ref name="Darth Bane: Path of Destruction" /> When [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] instituted the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], he declared himself the one and only Dark Lord of the Sith,<ref name="RoT" /> but by the time of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], the title was held by both the [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]]<ref name="AOTC" /> and the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]].<ref name="Fall">''[[The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader]]''</ref> It remained so until the rise of the [[Rule of One]], which like the original Sith Empire recognized only a single Dark Lord of the Sith, bringing the title full circle.

==Behind the scenes==
The term ''Dark Lord of the Sith'' was in the script of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']] as a title of Darth Vader,<ref name="secrets">''[[The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]''</ref> and although not mentioned in the dialogue of the [[Original trilogy]],<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref><ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref><ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> was mentioned in the novelizations<ref name="ANHn">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref><ref name="ESBn">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref> and comic adaptations.<ref name="SW1">[[Star Wars (1977) 1|''Star Wars'' (1977) 1]]</ref> 

While writing [[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy|''The Thrawn Trilogy'']], author [[Timothy Zahn]] originally planned for the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] to be called "the Sith"; thus making the man they worshipped, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the "Dark Lord of the Sith". However, this idea came into conflict with [[Lucasfilm]] and thus Zahn was forced to change it.<ref name="Insider36">{{InsiderCite|36|The Hand of Zahn}}</ref><ref name="DB">{{DB|species|noghri|Noghri}}</ref>

The background of the Dark Lords of the Sith and their nature as Jedi who turned to the dark side of the Force was first explored in [[1994]]<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> with [[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']].<ref name="DA" /> Further information was provided in [[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 1]],<ref name="FNU1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 1]]</ref> [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - Dark Lords of the Sith'']],<ref name="DarkLords">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - Dark Lords of the Sith'']]''</ref> and ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith]]''.<ref name="GAOTS">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith]]''</ref>
